instruction: Write load_factor(values): mean/peak for a nonempty list of nonnegative loads. Return0 if all values are0; reject empty/negative input with ValueError. Add docs and examples.

```python
def load_factor(values):
    """Mean-to-peak ratio; empty/negative loads are invalid."""
    if not values or any(v < 0 for v in values):
        raise ValueError("invalid loads")
    peak = max(values)
    return 0 if peak == 0 else (sum(values) / len(values)) / peak

# load_factor([2, 4]) -> 0.75
# load_factor([0, 0]) -> 0
```
